protocol.budgetRule: Before candidate generation, declare lite = 5,500,000; standard = 7,000,000; high = 9,000,000 integer asset bytes. Budgets are not chosen from observed winning transitions.
protocol.priorityRule: At the fixed 8,500,000-byte budget compare balanced priorities, model priority 8, and Earth photo priority 8; record all outcomes even when selections do not change.
protocol.allocation: Exact sparse Pareto allocation over the same complete measured valid candidate table; compare greedy and proportional baselines with the same table and constraints.
protocol.retention: Each source is copied to a fresh managed project. Existing measured projects and the earlier small demonstration are retained.

costDefinition: Wall time is measured from script start through demonstration assembly, before final evidence/report serialization. Stage times include physical setup, encoding, evaluation and filesystem work. Project costs and candidate subcomponents are nested accounting views, not quantities to sum again. Demonstration cache and ZIP/container storage are separate from selected asset bytes.

plateau.interpretation: The next threshold is computed from all combinations in this fixed measured table; no ungenerated candidate is implied.

packagingRevision.notes: Each tier retains manifest/recipe/policy/report JSON; the browser packages any feasible allocation from real candidate files. All three original local exports remain intact.
